appendix.title: Apache virtual host example configuration
appendix.para: The following example configuration shows a complete virtual host configuration for a HTTPS server. The configuration assumes that the host is at IP address 192.168.0.50. You should also notice that this setup relaxes the overly restrictive default settings to allow symbolic links and CGI programs to be executed.
Remember also that in addition to the virtual host configuration file the /etc/sysconfig/apache2 configuration also needs to be updated as described in a previous chapter to allow HTTPS traffic.

sect1.title: ssl-vhost.conf
sect1.para: The following shows an example of a complete virtual host configuration

note.para: The initial <VirtualHost _default_:443> will make these settings apply on all IP addresses that no other virtual host is bound to. Please observe that this is quite different from <VirtualHost *:443> which will match all IP addresses regardless if they are used by other virtual host or not.
The matching is valid only for numeric IP add not DNS names.

sect1.programlisting:
<VirtualHost _default_:443>
# General setup for the virtual host DocumentRoot "/srv/www/vhosts/ssl-htdocs" ServerName 192.168.0.50:443 ServerAdmin root@localhost ErrorLog /var/log/apache2/ssl-htdocs.err TransferLog /var/log/apache2/ssl-htdocs.access CustomLog /var/log/apache2/ssl-htdocs.info ssl_combined
DirectoryIndex index.html
RewriteEngine On RewriteOptions Inherit
HostnameLookups Off UseCanonicalName Off
ServerSignature On
Include /etc/apache2/conf.d/*.conf
<Directory /srv/www/vhosts/ssl-htdocs> AllowOverride All Options Indexes FollowSymLinks ExecCGI Order allow,deny Allow from all </Directory>
ScriptAlias /cgi-bin/ /srv/www/vhosts/ssl-cgi-bin <Directory /srv/www/vhosts/ssl-cgi-bin> AllowOverride All Options +ExecCGI -Includes Order allow,deny Allow from all </Directory>
SSLCertificateFile /etc/apache2/ssl.crt/server.crt SSLCertificateKeyFile /etc/apache2/ssl.key/server.key SSLEngine on SSLProtocol all -SSLv2 -SSLv3 SSLCipherSuite ALL:!aNULL:!eNULL:!SSLv2:!LOW:!EXP:!MD5:@STRENGTH
<Files ~ "\.(cgi|shtml|phtml|php3?)$"> SSLOptions +StdEnvVars </Files> <Directory "/srv/www/cgi-bin"> SSLOptions +StdEnvVars </Directory>
SetEnvIf User-Agent ".*MSIE [1-5].*" \ nokeepalive ssl-unclean-shutdown \ downgrade-1.0 force-response-1.0
</VirtualHost>
